offer.title: A seat has opened
offer.child: A place has opened for {participantName} in {productName}. Would you still like it?
offer.self: A place has opened for you in {productName}. Would you still like it?
offer.deadline: Please answer by {deadline}. After that the seat goes to the next family in line.
offer.confirmBody: We will offer it to the next family on the waitlist, and this offer cannot be reopened.
offer.error: Something went wrong and your answer was not saved. Please try again, or write to us at {supportEmail}.

accepted.title: The seat is saved
accepted.body: We have kept the place for you. You will find it in My SOG alongside everything else your family is signed up for.

declined.title: Thank you for telling us
declined.body: We have taken the place off your list. Because you answered, another family can have it today instead of it standing empty.

expired.title: This offer has run out
expired.body: A seat offer stays open for {days} days, and this one closed before we heard from you.
expired.declinePrompt: You are still on the waitlist. If your family no longer needs a place at all, you can tell us now and free it for someone else.
expired.confirmBody: We will take you off the waitlist. Joining again later would start you at the back of the queue.

used.title: This link has already been used
used.body: This invitation is no longer open. Everything your family is signed up for, and every place you are waiting on, is in My SOG.

invalid.title: This link did not work
invalid.body: It may have been cut short by your email app, or copied only part of the way. Try opening it from the email again, or write to us at {supportEmail} and we will help.
